lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits. Centroids form approximately vertical columns of 4-6 spots each, with spot diameter decreasing and spatial density increasing in the anterior-dorsal direction toward the head.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank; the most prominent dorsal ridge displays a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light pixels on the superior edge and deep shadows on the inferior edge, extending from the nuchal area toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 8-10 high-luminance blobs is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the anterior and medial sections of the fin's surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 6-8 small, elongated objects with low pixel intensity (commensal fish) is visible swimming ventrally, primarily concentrated beneath the pectoral fin and mid-abdominal region.
